name: Cheshire Ring
description: A classic 4–7 day circuit through Manchester, the Peak fringe and the Cheshire plain. Contrasting canals and plenty of locks.

name: Four Counties Ring
description: Cheshire, Shropshire, Staffordshire and the West Midlands — the Audlem and Bosley-free lock flights, Harecastle Tunnel and open countryside.

name: Warwickshire Ring
description: Birmingham, the Coventry and Oxford canals and the Grand Union — lots of locks (Hatton, Farmer's Bridge) and a good two-week cruise.

name: Stourport Ring
description: Birmingham Canal Navigations, the Stourbridge and Staffs & Worcs canals, the River Severn and the Worcester & Birmingham — locks galore.

name: Avon Ring
description: The Worcester & Birmingham, River Severn, River Avon and Stratford Canal — rivers and canals, and the famous Tardebigge flight.

name: Llangollen Canal
description: One of the most scenic canals in the country: lock flights, the Whitchurch and Ellesmere country, and the Pontcysyllte Aqueduct to Llangollen.
